subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Must-Read Books, Jerry Seinfeld Wisdom, Bizarre Machines for Relaxation, and David Hasselhoff to Kick Off Your Weekend

bullets.section: Retro turbo boost for your weekend
bullets.title: David Hasselhoff - True Survivor (from Kung Fury)
The Ministry of Time
bullets.creator: Kaliane Bradley
bullets.note: . Three or four friends over the past year have recommended this to me. I’m glad I finally took the bait. Time travel + humor + sex + very clever writing. From the description: “A time travel romance, a spy thriller, a workplace comedy, and an ingenious exploration of the nature of power and the potential for love to change it all. Welcome to _The Ministry of Time_, the exhilarating debut novel by Kaliane Bradley.” The cover design by [Alison Forner](https://www.instagram.com/aforner1/) is also brilliant; what she did with the font alone is awesome. Hard to pull off. If you want more time travel, or if you want to start with a shorter ride, I highly recommend [_This Is How You Lose the Time War_](https://www.amazon.com/This-How-You-Lose-Time/dp/1534430997/) by Amal El-Mohtar and Max Gladstone.

bullets.section: What I’m using to relax my low back and hips
bullets.title: Daiwa Felicity Swing Machine
bullets.note: Ignore the ridiculous chi vitalizing claims. This was recommended to me by a top soft-tissue therapist who works with household names. 10–15 minutes before bed does wonders for my lower back and sleep.

bullets.title: The Penguin
bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.primevideo.com/detail/The-Penguin/0K6XV0TUZEEAD63A683OX149MG), [Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/show/the-penguin/umc.cmc.19x702tdhe5kelq9tz0fcpqg9), [Hulu](https://www.hulu.com/series/the-penguin-2b442ca7-a7dd-44a5-880b-4afa7acb56f7)). The less you know about this series, the better one of the surprises will be. If you absolutely _must_ watch a trailer, [this is a good option](https://youtu.be/wcIOpkDoOx4?si=ojAbco-yngXgxkog), but I strongly encourage going in blind. This was recommended to me by several friends, and I had a thought I often have: “Another goddamn comic book thing? Thanks but no thanks.” And that’s coming from someone who collected comic books as a kid and who still has all of his boxes of polybagged comics. But… I was wrong. This one is incredibly well cast and well written. I loved it. Just buckle up for a lot of dark humor and dark plot twists. The series has 95% on Rotten Tomatoes for good reasons plus multiple accolades, including three Golden Globe Award nominations and a win.

bullets.title: “When I was starting out, I used to sit down and write a couple times a week. And then, one day, I was watching these construction workers go back to work. I was watching them kind of trudgin’ down the street... It was like a revelation to me, and I realized, ‘These guys don’t want to go back to work after lunch, but they’re goin’_... ’cause that’s their job!’ And I thought, ‘If they can exhibit that level of dedication for that job, I should be able to do the same.’ Just trudge your ass in!” — Jerry Seinfeld in Comedian_)
